subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose the raw startup catch-up limits, or define a higher-level public missed-run policy for restart catch-up?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but AGENTS.md treats config additions and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and the user need is skip/defer policy rather than only numeric internals.

options.title: Define public missed-run policy
options.body: Add a compatible default plus explicit global or per-job policy for skip, defer, stagger, or time-window catch-up before wiring the lower-level values.

options.title: Expose raw internal limits
options.body: Promote maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs directly to CronConfig if maintainers accept those numbers as the stable public API.

options.title: Decline new config for now
options.body: Keep catch-up behavior internal and address duplicate or burst delivery through safer scheduler defaults and documentation only.

recommendation.title: Define public missed-run policy
recommendation.body: Add a compatible default plus explicit global or per-job policy for skip, defer, stagger, or time-window catch-up before wiring the lower-level values.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and refactored the current startup catch-up path and is the strongest routing candidate for the config/product boundary decision.
